why.basis: Ruah, lei hnawng zat, tlang pang, lung chi leh lirnghing data live atanga dan anga chhut a ni. Kaihhruaina mai a ni a, tiamkamna a ni lo — sorkar thupek zawm fo rawh.
why.basis_plain: Hei hi ruah, lei hnawng, tlang pang leh lirnghing atanga kaihhruaina a ni a, tiamkamna a ni lo. Sorkar thupek zawm fo rawh.

preview.note: He hmun tlang pang, kawng, lui, thingkung leh minpui tlak tawhte hi mipui hman theih data atangin (SRTM, OpenStreetMap, MODIS, NASA) lak a ni. Lung chi, fault hla zawng leh hlauhawmna hnuaia mi leh hmunte chu finfiah a la ni lo — hlauhawmna level hi chhut dan tlangpui angin ngai rawh. Khawchin, lirnghing leh AI model chu Sikkim ang bawkin a kal.
preview.note_plain: He hmun map data ṭhenkhat finfiah a la ni lo, chuvangin he level hi chhut dan tlangpui angin ngai rawh.
